name: @mommo-codes/barkod
description: GTIN parsing, canonicalisation, match keys and GS1 classification. Compiled from Rust to WebAssembly.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build .. --target web --out-dir npm/wasm --out-name barkod_wasm && rm -f wasm/.gitignore
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
